FLOOD.title: Flood Emergency Safety & Evacuation Guidelines
instructions: Move to higher ground and follow official evacuation instructions immediately.
Avoid walking, swimming, or driving through moving floodwater.
Stay away from rivers, drainage channels, flooded basements, and submerged electrical equipment.
Prepare drinking water, essential medicines, flashlight, emergency contacts, and important documents in a waterproof bag.
Follow official weather forecasts and local disaster management authority updates.
FLOOD.source: NDMA (National Disaster Management Authority) & Central Water Commission

EARTHQUAKE.title: Earthquake Safety Protocols & Post-Tremor Guidelines
instructions: During shaking: DROP to the ground, COVER your head under a sturdy desk or table, and HOLD ON tight.
After shaking stops, evacuate damaged buildings carefully when it is safe to do so.
Avoid standing near windows, heavy furniture, damaged structures, fallen power lines, or gas pipelines.
Expect aftershocks. Be prepared to Drop, Cover, and Hold On again.
Do NOT use elevators in damaged buildings after tremors.

FIRE.title: Fire Emergency Safety & Smoke Inhalation Avoidance
instructions: Evacuate the affected area immediately using the nearest marked emergency exit.
If smoke is present, stay low to the floor and crawl under smoke toward safety.
Cover nose and mouth with a damp cloth to minimize toxic smoke inhalation.
Do NOT re-enter a burning or structurally compromised building for any reason.
Alert emergency services immediately and follow fire officials' instructions.
FIRE.source: State Fire Services & Fire Safety Standard Directives

CYCLONE.title: Severe Cyclone & Storm Surge Advisory
instructions: Follow official evacuation orders from weather authorities and local government.
Stay indoors in a secure interior room away from windows and glass doors during the storm.
Keep an emergency kit ready with drinking water, non-perishable food, medicines, battery radio, and charged phones.
Avoid coastal areas, flooded roads, weak structures, and fallen power lines.
Remain inside until emergency officials declare the eye of the storm and outer winds have safely passed.
CYCLONE.source: IMD (India Meteorological Department) & Disaster Response Units

LANDSLIDE.title: Landslide Hazard & Slope Safety Advisory
instructions: Move away quickly from slopes, hillsides, and areas showing signs of ground cracking or mud movement.
Avoid landslide debris flow channels, river valleys, and unstable mountain roads.
Listen for unusual sounds such as snapping trees or cracking boulders that indicate moving earth.
Follow official evacuation orders and move to stable, flat terrain immediately.

CHEMICAL_SPILL.title: Hazardous Chemical Spill & Toxic Gas Exposure Guidelines
instructions: Move upwind and uphill away from the spill or gas cloud area immediately.
Shelter indoors if advised: close all windows, doors, and shut down air conditioning or ventilation units.
Do NOT touch, walk through, or inhale unknown chemical fumes or liquids.
Seek medical assistance immediately if exposed to toxic vapours or skin irritants.

BUILDING_COLLAPSE.title: Structural Failure & Building Collapse Safety Guidelines
instructions: Evacuate damaged or cracking structures immediately via safe stairways (do not use elevators).
Stay clear of falling masonry, glass, overhead wiring, and unstable walls.
If trapped inside debris: cover mouth with clothing, tap on pipes or walls to signal search teams, and conserve oxygen.

DEFAULT.title: General Disaster Safety & Emergency Precautions
instructions: Follow instructions issued by local emergency management officials and law enforcement.
Keep location sharing active on your mobile device for rapid emergency responder dispatch.
Stay in a safe shelter away from immediate hazards and keep essential contacts ready.
